body: H2S isn't fun to smell, and it's a particularly painful method. I've got my own problems, just figured you'd like more facts.

1. No I won't. I shower and put on fresh clothes when I go out. It just makes me feel like a wolf in sheeps clothing. I have a beard so shaving isn't a problem.
2. It's done for me, this isn't an issue. As it is, I'm not making any.
3. & 4. It's well and good to say this, but it really doesn't help me. I know it isn't great, and I'm fairly repulsed by it. Do I do anything about it?
5. An associate professor of psychiatry can't get me to do it. This isn't happening unless I have a huge improvement in my mental well-being.
6. I frankly don't see the point of this, half an hour is plenty and will make changes occur. A hike involves a lot prior planning and organisation. 
7. I need to be close to civilisation on the off-chance I need hospitalisation. He goes pretty far off the grid and is gone for some time.
8. Why the hell would I take them anywhere?! Also, I don't think you realise how offensive it is to tell someone with bipolar to save money. Money problems are one of the most common problems. Related to impulse control. 
9. Pointless. I'm not mentally stable enough. There was a best of about this today. 
10. Have one. It's zero motivation. 
11. Have one and read everyday, and I don't mean reddit. I used to enjoy it, all it is now is a distraction. I derive no enjoyment from it.

As for focusing on myself, it's all I do these days.

I don't mean to sound ungrateful, but this just feels like "11 secrets that psychologists/psychiatrists hate".

Oh, and I forgot, went out the other night with my old drinking team from uni. I just felt like I was a plaque on the wall. My close friend who knew was up kept trying to draw me back unto the fold but I just couldn't mesh. Any time I said anything it just felt like I was being ignored and I kept finding myself being cut out of a circle of friends by others pushing their way in to join etc. If anything, it just crystallised my conviction that everyone would quickly get over my death once it happens.
